candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite-sheet for an existing 2D fighting game, THE PIT. Character design is Ahab Predator wearing his biomask, based on the project's supplied appearance. Keep the following visual identity: scratched silver elongated biomask with small ivory tusks, ochre mottled skin, black netting, layered silver armor, bone trophy on chest, dark dreadlocks, red cape with fur edge, shoulder cannon, double-handed long silver spear. Preserve his muscular proportions, equipment and detailed illustrated raster fighting-game sprite style. Draw real distinct animation poses, not a montage of unrelated characters.
Output one 1536 x 1024 landscape sheet with exactly EIGHT full-body sprites, on a precise FOUR-column TWO-row uniform grid (each cell 384 x 512). No text, labels, borders, numbers, floor, shadows, scenery, logos, or extra objects. Genuine transparent background and transparent gutters. Every sprite must fit within its own cell including the complete spear, cape, dreadlocks and feet, at least 16 pixels of clear margin. Keep constant scale, body anatomy, same armor, same masked face, same weapon held in two coherent hands, grounded feet at the same local baseline. Keep hands, thumbs and fingers anatomically coherent, no fused hands, no extra limbs, no detached accessories. Feet alternate clearly in the walk poses; do not slide both feet together.
Reading left-to-right:
TOP row cells1-4 = a FOUR-frame forward walk cycle: leading foot planted/other foot back; passing pose lifting rear foot; opposite foot planted; opposite passing pose. Keep the spear held diagonally across the body, no attack, cape and dreadlocks lag gently.
BOTTOM row cells1-2 = TWO distinct subtle idle breathing drawings in the same planted fighting stance; cells3-4 = TWO distinct standing high guard poses with the spear braced protectively before head and upper torso, knees flexed, no strike. These are gameplay motions, not graphic rotations, warps or enlarged copies. Consistent clean detailed raster comic-game rendering, readable at small size.
Every frame faces toward screen RIGHT, in a three-quarter side view. This is the player's native facing.
candidates.reason: Costume changed (shoulder fur and extra skulls); cells overlap.

candidates.prompt:
Production asset for a 2D fighting game. Create one NATIVE RIGHT-FACING AHAB PREDATOR MASKED sprite sheet. LANDSCAPE 1536x1024, 2 columns and 2 rows, exactly FOUR complete sprites, large clear margins, identical scale in all four 768x512 cells. EVERY BACKGROUND PIXEL IS PURE SOLID MAGENTA #FF00FF, including all gutters, no gradients, no light halos, no shadows, no background art. No text/grid/labels. Sharp, finely detailed painted comic-game raster rendering, not cute, not chibi.

Ahab is an ochre mottled-skinned muscular Yautja. Exact costume specification: elongated weathered silver biomask, rounded dome with four slanting forehead grooves, angular eyebrow edge, deep narrow eyes, round spiral cheek vents, two small ivory tusk-like fang projections at the mouth. Long black dreadlocks with sparse brown metallic rings. Jagged overlapping heavy silver armour plates, asymmetrical segmented silver shoulder/chest armour, black diamond body netting, one SINGLE long pale animal skull trophy fixed to the center upper chest (not a necklace of many skulls), silver gauntlets, brown fur only at the hip belt, silver groin guard and segmented silver shin armour. Shoulder cannon stays on his anatomical LEFT shoulder and wrist-blade housing on RIGHT forearm.
He holds one long silver spear with one broad split/two-pointed blade head, shaft held securely in BOTH hands (right hand at lower shaft near hip, left hand upper shaft before chest), diagonal across torso. Entire spear and cape fit inside cell, never cross cell edges. Both hands visibly grip the SAME shaft; no extra arms/fingers/spears. Camera three-quarter fighting side view aimed to the RIGHT, not pure profile: enough front chest to see the skull trophy. Body proportions muscular and tall, unchanged between poses.

Top left cell: neutral fighting stance, spear held diagonally, knees slightly bent.
Top right cell: same planted stance with subtle inhalation, chest a little raised and dreads/cape slightly lagged; a distinct idle breathing drawing, feet stay at the exact same anchors.
Bottom left cell: standing high guard, spear braced before upper body, knees moderately bent; still faces RIGHT.
Bottom right cell: same high guard under a small absorbed impact, shoulders lean back slightly, elbows bend, both hands remain on shaft, feet retain same anchors.
Within each cell all support feet at y=480 local; body crown around y=95, no independent per-pose scaling. Clear magenta margin16px minimum around every weapon and body. No new ornaments, anatomy drift, mirrored equipment, crossed overlapping hands, warped mask, duplicate limbs.
